name: Obsidian Energy Ltd.
summary: Obsidian Energy Ltd. engages in the exploration, development, and production of oil and natural gas in Western Canada. Its portfolio of properties includes unitized and non-unitized light oil, heavy oil, and natural gas production. The company was formerly known as Penn West Petroleum Ltd. and changed its name to Obsidian Energy Ltd. in June 2017. Obsidian Energy Ltd. is headquartered in Calgary, Canada.
